move: boarding pass flips in, route draws with plane, gate flips, stub tears
how: Over a drifting ocean background a 760x400 white boarding pass fromTo's rotateY -75, x -120, opacity 0 to rotateY -6 with 1.1s expo.out at 1% of the 9s, then rocks rotateY 4 / rotateX 3 with a 3.6s sine.inOut yoyo. Its contents fade up y 20 with 0.07s stagger (power3.out) from 5%, and 44 barcode bars print in with scaleY from the bottom (0.012s stagger) at 11%. From 17% to 52% the blue route path draws drawSVG 0 -> 100% with power2.inOut while a plane icon follows the same bezier with MotionPathPlugin (autoRotate) in sync. At 33% the gate value rolls out yPercent -100, changes text in onComplete, and rolls back from yPercent 100 with back.out(1.6); the status pill pulses scale 1.08 yoyo eight times then turns amber and reads 'Final call' at 58%. At 84% the stub slides x 60, rotate 3 and fades (power3.in); at 91% the pass flips rotateY 70, x 160 and fades (expo.in).
adapt: Replace the airline, flight number, airports, times, passenger, gate/seat values and the accent blue (#2f6bff); reshape the route path d attribute (both #p and #p2). Keep the 1.1s expo.out flip-in, the 3.2s power2.inOut draw and the 0.6s expo.in flip-out.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the pass, the SVG arc and 44 seeded barcode bars; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with flip-in at 0.011D, draw 0.167D-0.52D, gate flip at 0.333D, status change at 0.578D, tear at 0.844D and exit at 0.911D. DrawSVGPlugin and MotionPathPlugin must be registered; the motionPath path/align ids must be unique per instance or replaced with element references scoped to el; the onComplete/onReverseComplete text swaps stay as they are.
caveats: text changes use onComplete/onReverseComplete, so a seek that jumps over those tweens without playing them shows stale text
from() tweens on contents and bars have default immediateRender
full-frame background image with brightness/saturate filter
loop does not close: pass flips away
